briefdescription.para: Helper functions for producing compound hashes.

detaileddescription.para: For example given a class with fields a, b, c, d of any type, a compound hash can be computed via: int hash = Hash.of(a, Hash.of(b, Hash.of(c, Hash.of(d))));
